card.text: Explore Thyra in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: Convex light-curve reconstruction. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: DAMIT 154 shape model
shape.summary: Convex light-curve reconstruction with a published 90–94 km diameter fit range; the archive mesh uses 92 km. Unusual scattering parameters make its vertical shape uncertain. The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative.

elevation.title: DAMIT 154 radial height
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 46 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
